baseline_disclosure: Specification informed by previously inspected case outputs, service-event associations and published-solution knowledge. No blind-discovery claim. Case-specific names, addresses and hashes are excluded from candidate-generation rules.
scope: Same-case, same-host memory and disk evidence; capture identities retained separately.
implementation_gate: Validate all inputs and their extraction status; missing/failed is not a negative finding.
Implement and test the predicates below before marking the specification frozen.
Require all ranking evidence to reference exact source records and an action candidate.
Save specification, implementation, input and configuration hashes plus UTC freeze date before the ranked run.
Never modify a frozen version; amendments require a new version and a separate run.

identity_policy.path_rules: Preserve originals; lowercase Windows separators; device, environment and short-name aliases require evidence-backed mappings. Basename-only is weak.
identity_policy.file_reference: Prefer verified volume identity plus MFT record and sequence when available. Record numbers alone are reusable.
identity_policy.historical_hostname: Preserve event Computer; do not invent aliases or reject same-image historical records as foreign-host proof. Unverified aliases limit association strength.
identity_policy.absence: Only not_found_in_available_inventory until source coverage, paths, allocation, host and acquisition gaps are established.

closed_actions.action_evidence: Service-install/change event or explicit service-change records; service configuration alone establishes configuration only.
suspicion_predicates: Configured interpreter performs an explicit pipe-write or download-and-execute command
Associated executable has independently reviewed malicious-content evidence
closed_actions.limitations: Legitimate administration and acquisition services remain alternatives; installation is not payload execution.

closed_actions.action_evidence: Process/execution event or a compatible process instance with command line.
suspicion_predicates: Encoded command whose decoded content performs download-and-execute or credential-access behavior
closed_actions.limitations: A configured service command is not proof the command executed; encoding alone does not establish malicious intent.

closed_actions.action_evidence: Executable-memory region linked to a compatible process, with thread-start overlap or reviewed payload structure/content.
suspicion_predicates: Thread Win32 start address falls inside private executable memory and the same region contains reviewed payload structure
Executable private region contains independently reviewed injection-related payload evidence
closed_actions.limitations: RWX, MZ headers and missing backing paths alone are insufficient; JIT/runtime and legitimate loading alternatives must be reviewed.

closed_actions.action_evidence: Verified main-image mapping/content inconsistent with its backing executable, with executable-memory evidence.
suspicion_predicates: Main-image identity/content contradiction survives relocation, version and capture-gap checks
closed_actions.limitations: Name/path resemblance, a missing DLL record or RWX alone cannot establish hollowing.

closed_actions.action_evidence: Comparable loader/list and mapping/scan observations with stable object identity.
suspicion_predicates: Visibility disagreement survives the defined baseline, unloading and stale-object review
closed_actions.limitations: False loader flags and scan-only records are anomalies until contextual review; no automatic rootkit mapping.

closed_actions.action_evidence: Compatible memory handle and explicitly deleted disk record with verified file identity.
suspicion_predicates: Deletion relates to an independently supported suspicious action involving the same object
closed_actions.limitations: Normal deletion is possible; filescan alone does not establish ownership, deletion or intent.

closed_actions.action_evidence: Actual task/Run-key record or corresponding creation/change event.
suspicion_predicates: Configured command meets A02 behavior predicates
Verified referenced payload has independently reviewed malicious-content evidence
closed_actions.limitations: A mechanism's presence alone is not maliciousness or execution.

closed_actions.action_evidence: Separate NTFS SI/FN timestamps or documented partner detector output with source records.
suspicion_predicates: SI/FN divergence survives normal filesystem behavior review and relates to a supported suspicious object
closed_actions.limitations: Generic MACB exports and whole-second timestamps alone are insufficient; partner score is not an automatic verdict.

observation_rules.scan_only_process: Compare unique PID sets and logical instances; preserve termination and PID reuse. A scan-only record is Tier 3 until an action is supported.
observation_rules.parent_relationship: Review compatible parent/child lifetimes and command lines. Missing parent or services-to-shell lineage alone is not a malicious action.
observation_rules.network: Preserve every row and group tuples separately. PID/name agreement is not liveness; endpoint observations alone do not establish C2 or T1071.
observation_rules.missing_executable_or_module: Record inventory coverage and unresolved paths; do not infer deletion/concealment from an unmatched name.

unmapped_family_policy: Retain and flag for review; zero ranking contribution until explicitly mapped. Never create an independent family per unknown record.

independence_policy.count: Distinct action-relevant corroboration groups after deduplicating underlying object and derivation lineage, not plugin or row counts.
specific_cases: pslist/psscan/pstree views of one process count once.
malfind/VAD bytes/thread overlap support one runtime behavior; do not inflate counts from derived descriptions.
svcscan and registry configuration share a corroboration group.
A service-install event is distinct from service configuration, but must support the same action and service identity.
Filesystem metadata, recovered-file hash and derived detector signals do not independently count as three actions.
Equal endpoint tuples are a grouped view, not automatically identical objects or independent connections.

loader_baselines.pattern: Process main executable with InLoad=true, InMem=true, InInit=false
loader_baselines.required_context: Same process instance, image base and verified mapped main-image path; basename alone insufficient.
loader_baselines.effect: Explain loader initialization flag only; retain the record and all unrelated findings.

loader_baselines.pattern: Mapped non-image data file absent from loader lists
loader_baselines.required_context: VAD/image classification and actual mapping context establish non-image data; extension or False flags alone insufficient.
loader_baselines.effect: Explain list absence only; do not label process benign.

ranking.tier_1: Closed action with at least one satisfied suspicion predicate, two or more relevant corroboration groups, full-path or content identity, compatible known times, and no unresolved material identity/coverage contradiction.
ranking.tier_2: Closed action and satisfied suspicion predicate, but only one relevant corroboration group or unresolved timing/identity. Never a confirmed-malicious verdict by tier alone.
ranking.tier_3: Observation/anomaly, weak association, unresolved absence, or suspicion predicate not established.
ranking.baseline: Only observations meeting an explicit verified baseline; not a blanket process verdict.
ranking.missing_values: Unknown does not mean compatible; context-only evidence contributes zero corroboration groups.

attack_mapping: Separate evidence-backed reasoning after assessment; RWX is not hollowing, hidden flags are not rootkit proof, service parentage is not service abuse, and endpoints alone are not application-protocol C2.
known_implementation_gaps: Loader baseline predicates are not yet implemented or verified.
Existing assessment collects observations; it does not implement the closed-action classifier or tier ranking.
Additional event/task/cache/NTFS extraction coverage remains incomplete.
No real-case accuracy metric or blind validation is established.
